items.title: Wendy Oxenhorn — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I missed all the Bob Dylans and the Odettas, and all that live music scene. Most of the people we ended up helping, and a lot of the legends, I never got to hear them in person.

ctx.x: I don’t know exactly what years we’re talking about, but it was a very different time, and the Village was a very different place.

Yeah, I came, sadly, at the tail end of that. I missed the glory moments. I missed all the Bob Dylans and the Odettas, and all that live music scene. Most of the people we ended up helping, and a lot of the legends, I never got to hear them in person. Which is painful. But I caught a few.
So after the Swiss ladies, you’re living with these two dancers on 10th Street, and at 17 you have an injury to your knee...
